card.name: Footnote digits glued to words
card.fires_on: A lone digit stuck right after a word or number with no space, acting as a footnote or superscript marker, or a digit inside a code. Mostly in dose tables and author affiliation lists.

modes.label: Footnote number after dose
modes.description: A superscript-style digit attached to a dose or table entry.
modes.example: Adults 20 mg or 40 mg<<1>> once daily for up to 6 months

modes.label: Affiliation or table digit
modes.description: A digit marker after a name or column heading in author lists or tables.

modes.label: Digit inside a name
modes.description: A digit within a drug or arm name, or a space before a code.
modes.example: Rd Continuous, Rd<<1>>8, and MPT Arms
